Developer - Pebblecreek Studio

About the role
We are a small studio and we need a developer who can pick things up quickly and work with all of us. The role is broad and the exact projects will depend on what comes in. You will work directly with clients, so you should be comfortable explaining technical choices to people who do not write code themselves.

Responsibilities
- Help build and look after our client projects
- Talk to clients and teammates every day

Requirements
- Strong programming skills
- Experience with cloud platforms
- Good database knowledge
- Good communication
- Able to learn quickly

Benefits
- Friendly team and flexible hours
- Free lunch on Fridays
- Yearly learning budget and 25 days of paid leave
